description.text: Adds the Internal (staff / back-office) Razor Pages site. It calls ProjectName.API over HTTP and has no database access.
Adds the External (public / customer facing) Razor Pages site. It calls ProjectName.API over HTTP and has no database access.
Adds the ASP.NET Core Web API project (controllers + Swagger). The Internal and External sites only talk to this API, so it is always created when either site is selected.
Adds the business services layer used by the API (service interfaces + implementations). Also adds ProjectName.SqlRepository.
Adds the EF Core data project used by the API: ApplicationDbContext, entities, IRepository<T> and the repositories.
Adds an xUnit test project with NSubstitute mocks for ProjectName.Services (needs Services).
The EF Core database provider used by ProjectName.SqlRepository.
The SQL Server version to target. EF Core uses its compatibility level to decide which SQL it generates. Used only when the database is SQL Server.
The PostgreSQL server version to target. Used only when the database is PostgreSQL.
How the connection string signs in. PostgreSQL always uses a user name and password.
Server/host for the connection string. Leave blank for the default: (localdb)\MSSQLLocalDB, your-server.database.windows.net or localhost.
Database name. Leave blank to use the project name.
User name for a SQL login or PostgreSQL. Leave blank for sa / postgres.
Password for a SQL login or PostgreSQL (development only; use user-secrets or Key Vault for real secrets).

name.text: Connection string (optional - overrides the fields above)

description.text: A full connection string. If you enter one, the server, database, user and password fields are ignored.
Seeds a few sample customers when the API starts in Development.
Interactive API documentation in Development: Swagger UI (/swagger) or Scalar (/scalar). Both use the OpenAPI document Swashbuckle generates.

name.text: Secure the API with an API key (X-Api-Key)

description.text: The API requires an X-Api-Key header; Internal and External send it automatically (key generated per solution).
Adds /health to every project; the API also checks the database (HealthChecks.EntityFrameworkCore).
Structured logging to the console and rolling files, configured in appsettings.json.
Send unhandled exceptions (API and sites, plus browser JavaScript errors for Sentry and Raygun) to an error-monitoring service.

name.text: Error monitoring key (Sentry DSN / Raygun API key / App Insights connection string)

description.text: Sentry DSN, Raygun API key or Application Insights connection string. Leave blank to set it later in appsettings.json or user-secrets.
How staff sign in to ProjectName.Internal.
Directory (tenant) ID for Microsoft Entra ID sign-in. Can be set later in appsettings.json.
Application (client) ID of the app registration for the Internal site. Can be set later in appsettings.json.
How customers sign in to ProjectName.External.
When both sites use ASP.NET Core Identity: sign in to each site separately, or once for both (single sign-on with a shared cookie). The Internal site always needs the Staff or Admin role.
Users can turn on 2FA with an authenticator app (QR code) and get recovery codes. Used only with ASP.NET Core Identity.
Users can add passkeys (Windows Hello, Touch ID, security keys, phones) and sign in with them. Needs .NET 10 or later; ignored for .NET 8/9.

name.text: User admin UI in the Internal site (users, roles, lockout, 2FA reset)

description.text: Admins manage users and roles: create, lock/unlock, reset two-factor, remove passkeys, delete. Needs ASP.NET Core Identity on the Internal site.

name.text: Add retries / circuit breaker to API clients (Microsoft.Extensions.Http.Resilience)

description.text: Adds the standard resilience handler (Polly) to the sites' typed HttpClients.
jQuery version restored by LibMan (jsDelivr).
jQuery UI version restored by LibMan (cdnjs, includes all themes).
jQuery UI ThemeRoller theme used by the date picker, dialog, autocomplete, etc.
Bootstrap version restored by LibMan. The markup adapts to Bootstrap 4 or 5.
Plain Bootstrap or a free Bootswatch theme (bootswatch, same version as Bootstrap).
Font Awesome Free only (free icons package, no Pro).
Client-side validation for the forms, driven by the model's data annotations.
Sorting, paging and searching for tables marked with the js-datatable class.
Searchable drop-downs for selects marked with the js-select2 class.
Shows TempData messages as toast notifications.
Nicer confirm dialogs, for example before deleting a customer.
Charts on the Internal dashboard.
